source.quote_free_summary: In Line Dance, the division a competitor registers for 'is the gender they are and must be throughout a Dance Season'; a Line Dance competitor may compete in gender-specific divisions and/or non-gender-specific Choreography divisions.

requirement: A future UCWDC Line Dance profile must record the gender division a competitor registers for and hold it for the Dance Season; gender-specific and non-gender-specific divisions both exist.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: gender collection, columns, migrations, role-lock enforcement, UI.
interpretation_notes: Requires a declared gender-division attribute that DanceFlow does not have; any such attribute is the separate privacy decision in OD27-DF-0002. Verification of the declaration is not described in the text read.
decision_refs: OD-27 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B retain Studio/Custom role flexibility; document body limitations; retrospective audit PR #795)
